title: How this database is wired
appsEmptyHint: No app uses this database yet.
appsNext: Bind it to an app to inject the connection string as an environment variable.
appDialogBody: Open an app, go to its Environment tab and bind this database. The connection string is injected as an environment variable on the next deploy.
appDialogEnv: Variable name is set when you bind, for example DATABASE_URL.
dbHint: The engine and version running here. Connect or open the explorer to work with the data.
nodeHint: The server this database runs on. Open it to see its health and other workloads.
accessHint: Who can reach the database port. Private keeps it on the internal network only.
backupsHint: Scheduled copies of your data that you can restore from.
projectHint: Groups this database with related apps and shows it in project views.
outTitle: Where it runs and who can reach it
